statement: Earlier audited HERMES/FIFO full-track comparison has an inconclusive accuracy difference in its tested configuration
needed_evidence: Preserve scope, mixed-session limits and uncertainty when citing
claim_limit: Does not establish universal HERMES failure or equivalence

statement: Fresh causal scorer matches native attention and preserves input cache during the new GPU run
existing_evidence: CPU numerical tests; prepared runtime preflight
needed_evidence: Audited preflight.json from actual AutoDL execution
claim_limit: CPU checks do not certify this GPU invocation

statement: Fresh causal scoring recovers useful QA behavior compared with current HERMES
existing_evidence: Prepared eight-video outcome-selected screen; no completed new results supplied
needed_evidence: Validated paired answers, regressions, supporting examples and matched timing
claim_limit: Selected pilot cannot estimate population benefit; numerical attention agreement alone is insufficient

statement: The proposed method is distinct from the closest existing mechanisms
needed_evidence: Written algorithm and full-method/code comparison with nearest work
claim_limit: A new name, generic combination or reproduction correction does not establish novelty

statement: The original method improves a useful QA/memory/cost trade-off over matched controls
needed_evidence: Frozen treatment, current/fresh/FIFO and nearest feasible prior control, ablations and appropriate uncertainty
claim_limit: No invented improvement percentage; include regressions and total auxiliary cost

statement: The claimed benefit generalizes beyond development cases
existing_evidence: Existing benchmark outcomes have already informed research direction
needed_evidence: Appropriate independent confirmation and/or compatible additional setting with source-overlap checks
claim_limit: A subset of an inspected benchmark is not an untouched external test

existing_evidence: Prior timing scopes and new shared-feature replay design
needed_evidence: Separate full-system arrival, decode, encoder, maintenance and query measurements if claiming this
claim_limit: Replay timing excludes shared vision preparation and does not establish live latency

statement: Submission package meets journal and graduation requirements
existing_evidence: Supplied Neurocomputing guide; user says Q1 mandatory and original method required
needed_evidence: Final manuscript, correct article type, qualifying ranking category/year, authorship/milestone checks and author approval
claim_limit: Author guide does not verify Q1 or guarantee acceptance
